Case reference: 2018009360.CaseDesc: On February 18, 1987, George Christie was last seen at the intersection of Broadview Avenue and Queen Street East in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004580.CaseDesc: On the morning of July 23, 1991, a group of 8 individuals left Igloolik, Nunavut and headed to Hall Beach, Nunavut.  The group travelled using a 24 foot freighter canoe powered by a 30 hp outboard motor.  It was a stormy day with heavy rain and approximately 24 km north of Hall Beach, the canoe hit ice, filled with water and capsized.  Only one occupant made it back to shore.

Case reference: 2014001384.CaseDesc: On March 12, 1974, Gilles Larose was seen for the last time in Vancouver, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2021050990.CaseDesc: On November 4, 2021, Antony Anuj was last heard from via text message. The origin tower signals of the texts were traced to the Niagara Falls, Ontario area.

Case reference: 2018039090.CaseDesc: On December 6, 1996, at approximately 10:00 a.m., San Lee was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, San was terminally ill and despondent.

Case reference: 2014005084.CaseDesc: On February 1, 2008, it is suspected Kevin Leroux went through the ice on his ATV, near St Joseph's Cove, Newfoundland and Labrador. Kevin's ATV was recovered several months later, about 22 km from where he was suspected of going through the ice but his body was never found.

Case reference: 2020007351.CaseDesc: On October 8, 1981, at approximately 3:00pm, Maria Cowan was last seen as she left her home with a friend to go shopping in Toronto, Ontario.

Coat: Leather, Brown, Fur on collar and sleeves

Case reference: 2014006619.CaseDesc: On November 5, 2008, Flanel Colo was seen for the last time as he left the Intervalle Centre in the Longue-Pointe District in Montreal, Quebec. Flanel suffers from a paranoid personality disorder, and may have possibly returned to Haiti.

Case reference: 2019068654.CaseDesc: On November 16, 2019, Lara Parkin was seen for the last time in the South-West District of Montreal, Quebec. Lara is known to frequent Montreal’s downtown area and parks. She is also known to travel by foot or by public transit. During the time of her disappearance, Lara left her apartment without bringing any of her belongings.

Case reference: 2014005676.CaseDesc: On August 27, 2011, Jimmy Larrivée was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Jimmy had indicated that he wanted to spend the day in Rigaud, Quebec. That day, he was seen at a tanning salon on Monk Boulevard in the Ville-Émard District of Montreal. Jimmy hasn’t been seen or heard from him since.

Jewelry: Brown, Necklace with a cross-shaped pendant
Scar: Upper Left Back, Left shoulder blade

Case reference: 2014006329.CaseDesc: On November 22, 2013, David Czerman was taken to Surrey Memorial Hospital for substance impairment.  Later that day, David discharged himself from the hospital and was given a bus ticket at approximately 19:40 hours. He has not been seen by his neighbours or family since November 21, 2013.  David was depressed and on pain medication for a medical condition.  Family described David as a recluse, with no friends and only left his residence to go to the local pharmacy as he had trouble walking.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Dragon, Rose, bones skull
Left Forearm, Smurf, eagle, worm, heart
Right Forearm, Wizard, devil, rose, bird

Case reference: 2014004267.CaseDesc: On March 2, 2016, Jason MacMillan was reported missing. His brother last saw Jason on December 19, 2002 at 00:30 am when they were together on Jasper Avenue and 102 Street in Edmonton, Alberta.

Scar: Neck, Scar on his neck in the throat area
Tattoo: Left Hand, Cross, feather and wolf

Case reference: 2026036805.CaseDesc: Scott Rooney was last seen leaving his vehicle on March 24, 2025 at 8:42 a.m., and was seen walking in the area of Goat Island, Niagara Falls, USA. At the time of his disappearance, Scott was experiencing feelings of despondency.

Hair: Brown, Short, Short reddish-brown hair and brown/white goatee

Case reference: 2014001907.CaseDesc: Mary Rose Keadjuk was last seen between late June and August 1990 in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories, and was reported missing in September 1990. At the time of her disappearance, Mary Rose was residing at the Gold Range Hotel. In 2003, partial human remains were discovered in Yellowknife, and forensic DNA analysis determined that the remains were those of Mary Rose Keadjuk in 2018. The investigation into her disappearance  is still active and ongoing.

Teeth: Dental records indicate 1 tooth treated and 6 teeth absent.

Case reference: 2014032043.CaseDesc:
On May 22nd, 1970, Philomena Sisson, age 68, was reported missing by her son, Harry Jack.  She had gone missing a few days earlier from his house on Boys Rd. in Duncan, BC.  Mrs. Sisson was reported to be an alcoholic who occasionally went missing for several days at a time. She also suffered from dementia. 
 
Mrs. Sisson's last surviving son has since passed away.  There was never any indication of foul play in her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014003132.CaseDesc: On December 29, 1978, Sharon Drover was seen for the last time in downtown St. John's, Newfoundland & Labrador. Sharon left her boarding house located on Livingstone Street and arrived for her evening shift at the McDonald’s restaurant located on Kenmount Road where she finished her shift after midnight.  Investigators believe Sharon intended to hitchhike home after her shift.

Case reference: 2013000046.CaseDesc: On June 27, 2004, Richard McGuire was seen for the last time in the Nouveau-Rosemont district of Montreal, Quebec. Richard's vehicle, a Ford Windstar, was later found in a garage located in the municipality of St-Elzear in the La Nouvelle-Beauce Regional County in Quebec.

Case reference: 2014006175.CaseDesc: On July 8, 2013, at approximately 5:30 a.m., Jason Bathily and his twin sister, Clarene Bathily, were seen for the last time with their mother, Adelyne Mounga, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014001763.CaseDesc: Melvin Lair was last seen at approximately 3 p.m., on December 24, 1986 at his residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance, Melvin was feeling despondent.

Tattoo: Chest, Rolling Stones Tongue and lips logo and a heart with letters "JJ"

Case reference: 2012020055.CaseDesc:
The body of an Asian male was discovered by cleaning staff at the Northbrook Inn in Grand Rapids, Manitoba.  The individual had checked in at 15:30h after arriving on the bus from Winnipeg.  At 18:00h cleaning staff entered the room to find the occupant deceased in a chair.
It was learned that the subject checked into the hotel under the name "CHERON, Deoung".  A small black bag containing herbal medication was located in the room, which after translation from Korean revealed the prescription was issued to "PARK, Seng Dae"(variation of spelling PARK, Sang Dae).  It should be noted that the bus ticket-stub was located with the deceased identified "DUNG" as the individual who purchased the ticket.
Numerous checks were made with variety of agencies in an attempt to determine the man's identity.  It is believed he may be of Korean or Chinese decent.

Case reference: 2024063274.CaseDesc: Karl Olivier Desmeules was last seen on November 24, 2024 around 5:30 p.m. in the borough of Saint-Laurent, in Montreal, Quebec. Karl Olivier may have been despondent at the time of his disappearance and there hasn't been any news regarding his whereabouts since. The family of Karl Olivier have reasons to fear for his safety.

Case reference: 2014003613.CaseDesc: Larry Mattis was last seen on March 10, 1983 when he was taken to the Edmonton, Alberta airport by a friend and dropped off for a flight to Toronto, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance, Larry was living a high-risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2023039179.CaseDesc: Denis Taylor was last seen on July 22, 2023 at the Bulpit Lake Family Camp, located on Stringer Road in Carlow Mayo Township, East of Bancroft, Ontario. Denis planned to meet everyone in the common beach area after a brief nap in his cabin, which was located a distance away, but he never arrived. Denis may have woken up disoriented in the new cabin and taken the wrong path to the communal area.

Shirt: Blue, White, Long sleeve checkered shirt

Case reference: 2012020041.CaseDesc: Carolyn Pruyser was last seen at a Mohawk service station in Peace River, Alberta, shortly after midnight on May 17, 1984.  Carolyn's vehicle was found abandoned a short distance from her parents' home, with the keys and her purse still inside.

Blouse: Yellow, Orange, Short Sleeve "V" Neck Blouse

Case reference: 2012020159.CaseDesc: In July 2004, the remains of an unidentified man were found on the shore of the Fraser River in Richmond, British Columbia. The man had good dental work and had a gold tooth in his left lower jaw. It is estimated that he may have died in 2003 or early 2004.

Case reference: 2005069040.CaseDesc: Yaseen is believed to be with his mother, Marina Zlonikova. They may be in the Ukraine.

Case reference: 2014002404.CaseDesc: On June 11, 1988, Andrew Flett was walking with others to the cutline. He did not arrive at the site, and it was assumed that he had returned to camp. He was reported missing three days later to the RCMP, and an extensive search was conducted. Andrew has not been located, and his whereabouts are currently unknown.

Shirt: Red, Black, Plaid and button up

Case reference: 2014002883.CaseDesc: George Myrick was last seen on March 16, 1987, when he went duck hunting, but he never returned to St. Shott’s, Newfoundland and Labrador.

Case reference: 2006022399.CaseDesc: Jocelyn "Josh" Blais was last seen in a bait shop in Ignace, Ontario. He and a friend were headed to Cecil Lake (24 kilometres north of Ignace and 1 kilometre east off Hwy. 599) for a day of fishing. His overturned boat was later discovered.

Case reference: 2016070415.CaseDesc: On December 2, 2016, Houda Doumi left Canada with her two children, Zineb and Rayan Lahrim and connected at the John F. Kennedy Airport in New York City, USA, where they then travelled on to Cairo, Egypt. It is believed that Houda and the children are actually in the United Arab Emirates.

Case reference: 2014004448.CaseDesc: Carmelo Tomasino was last seen on January 19, 2004 in Montreal, Quebec. Carmelo's absence and not calling home is out of character.

Tattoo: Chest, Hearts with the text "Amanda and Brenda"

Case reference: 2010003499.CaseDesc:
On March 21, 2010 Chung Law left work on Dundas St, London ON. He told his employer that he was experiencing some stress and would be taking a couple of days off. Chung spoke to his wife, who lives in Vaughan, ON, and told her he was coming home for a visit. He spoke to his employer the next day, saying he was in Toronto and that he did not want to return to work in London. Chung never made it home. Investigation has revealed that he may have travelled to Toronto by bus. 

In April, 2011 a right foot contained within a black boot was located in the river flats of the Thames River in Elgin County. The area was searched and no further remains were found. DNA confirmed that the foot was that of Chung.

Scar: Left Thigh, Surgery scar on upper left thigh

Case reference: 2013000037.CaseDesc: On November 29, 2001, Henry Murillo Asprilla was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. On that day, he had a meeting with lawyers, which he attended with his ex-wife. After the meeting he drove his ex-wife home. Henry has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2024022714.CaseDesc: Wendy Lafortune was last seen at approximately 4:00 p.m. on May 1, 2024, on Lasalle Boulevard in Greater Sudbury, Ontario.  The possibility of foul play in her disappearance has not been ruled out.

Case reference: 2014004972.CaseDesc: Asim Chaudhry was last seen leaving his residence on July 20, 2007 at 1400hrs to study for an upcoming exam at Simon Fraser University. Asim was despondent in the past.

Hair: Black, Brush Cut, Has a beard
Pants: Cotton, Grey, Sweat Pant, Sweat pants
Sweater: Cotton, Grey, Hooded with "Russel Athletic" in red and blue writing

Case reference: 2012020004.CaseDesc: Jafar Imenpour, 74 years of age, who was visiting the Lower Mainland area of British Columbia from Iran, was reported missing on September 25, 2011.  Mr. Imenpour had not returned to his family residence after he had left for a 15 minute walk in Port Coquitlam, B.C. He does not speak English and does not know anyone other than his family in this area.

Case reference: 2006018999.CaseDesc: Sean MacIntyre was 13 years old at the time of a boating accident on July 25, 1980. The boat he was in started to take on water just after leaving Cockburn Island. The boat sank quickly in Lake Huron, North Channel, 2 kilometres Southwest of Bigsby Island. Occupants of the boat put on life jackets. Sean slipped out of his life jacket and is presumed  drowned. His body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2012020110.CaseDesc: On September 23 2000, Nathalie Godbout was seen for the last time in the Saint-Romuald district in Lévis, Quebec. Nathalie was the mother of two children.

Case reference: 2020028325.CaseDesc: On May 2, 2020, the body of a man was found on the banks of the Saint-Lawrence River in the area of Notre-Dame-des-Sept-Douleurs, Quebec.

Sweater: Cotton, Black, T-Shirt, "Kirkland" brand, size medium
Underwear: Cotton, Black, "Fruit of the Loom" brand, boxer style

Case reference: 2014003430.CaseDesc: Alim Hasan was last seen by his mother in Burnaby on March 21, 1990, when he was returning to his residence in Edmonton via Grey Hound Bus. Alim had a history of mental illness. On April 6, 1990, an unknown person left one of Alim’s luggage at the front door of Hope RCMP Detachment.

Luggage: Synthetic, Red, White, Sports Bag, Red Sports bag with white trim

Case reference: 2012020106.CaseDesc: Danielle Boisvert, 18 years old, disappeared November 6, 1979. On that day, Danielle was last seen leaving a bar in Montreal-North, Québec.

Case reference: 2014005961.CaseDesc: Chris Metallic was last seen in Sackville, New Brunswick, at around 3 a.m. on Sunday, November 25, 2012. He had been attending a party at a residence in Sackville on Saturday night. After receiving information that a person was observed at approximately 5:30 a.m. on Sunday walking on Upper Aboujagane Road, authorities focused their search in a wooded area and river off Route 940 heading toward Shemogue.

Deformity: Unknown, Crooked fingers on left hand

Case reference: 2014005443.CaseDesc: Paolo Renda was last seen on May 20, 2010 in the Montréal-Nord borough of Montreal, Quebec. Paolo's vehicle was later located on Gouin Street in Montreal. Paolo has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2010001199.CaseDesc: Michael Hinsperger was in a canoe on Carson Lake, Barry's Bay, at 3:00 P.M. on May 13th 2010. The canoe was recovered but Michael has not been located.

Jacket: Black, Yellow lettering "Harley Davidson Owners club"

Case reference: 2014001699.CaseDesc: On July 29, 1980, Marcel Pelissier was reported missing by his sibling to police in Boisbriand, Quebec. Marcel left his residence in a rented vehicle on the morning of May 13, 1980, around 5:30 a.m., with his dog, a Doberman named Hans. Marcel was last seen heading in the direction of St. Jovite, Quebec, and it is known that he was involved in narcotics, but he has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2016050062.CaseDesc: On August 31, 2016, Jami Springer was last seen in Moncton, New Brunswick.  Since then, no one has heard or seen Jami, and the police consider her disappearance as suspicious.

Case reference: 2006004799.CaseDesc: Ralph Monague and Curtis Smith were passengers on the Christian Island Ferry travelling between Cedar Point and Christian Island on December 22, 1985, when they fell over board in stormy conditions.

Case reference: 2015015784.CaseDesc: Richele Bear was reported missing to the Regina Police Service on September 5, 2013. She was last seen on August 9, 2013 leaving a residence in the 900 block of Rae Street in the North Central District of Regina, Saskatchewan. Through investigation, we have confirmed Richele to be the victim of a homicide.  Her remains however, have not been located.

Scar: Forehead, Teardrop shape; right upper in hairline (25mm)
Left Upper Arm, A round inoculation scar (10mm)

Case reference: 2019043680.CaseDesc: On July 29, 2019, Rachid Jalifi left his apartment in West Vancouver, British Columbia and was confirmed to have boarded a flight to Mexico. Rachid was last heard from on July 31, 2019 and has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003424.CaseDesc: On December 5, 1992, Marie Trahan was last seen in Petit-Shippagan, New Brunswick.  Marie's abandoned vehicle was later located at the wharf.

Case reference: 2021049342.CaseDesc: Isabelle Perron, a resident of Longue-Rive, Quebec, was last seen on September 2, 2021 in Forestville, Quebec. Isabelle was conducting a transaction at a Desjardins bank branch. Since that time, there has been no contact from Isabelle, and her whereabouts remain unknown.

Mark: Left Nostril, Black and brown wound

Case reference: 2015066612.CaseDesc: On December 7, 2015, Sheree Fertuck was seen for the last time driving a red 1998 International semi truck and trailer near Kenaston, Saskatchewan. The following morning her semi was located with several personal items inside it, including her cellular phone, keys and jacket.

Case reference: 2014002360.CaseDesc: On August 25, 1996, Benoit Lachance was seen for the last time in the Pointes-Aux-Trembles District in Montreal, Quebec. Benoit was a member of a motorcycle club called the "Rowdy Crew" and drove a blue Chevrolet Camaro.

Scar: Middle Back, Bullet still in the back

Case reference: 2011762660.CaseDesc: Brittany Stalman was last seen on Crawford Drive, Delta, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014004675.CaseDesc: Jean-Louis Bourgeault was last seen on September 12, 2005 in Montreal, Quebec. Jean-Louis left the Suzanne Blanchard Pavillon, a mental health resource linked to the Louis Hippolyte Lafontaine Hospital. Jean-Louis was homeless in downtown Montreal prior to entering the Pavillon.

Case reference: 2014001533.CaseDesc: On September 10, 1988, Alojz Bracek was on a hunting trip in the Tony Tower area near Fox Creek, Alberta, with two hunting partners and went missing when he was separated from them.

Case reference: 2012020123.CaseDesc: Paul Côté left his residence on June 13, 2000 and hasn’t been seen since. Paul's car, a black 2000 Chevrolet Blazer, was located a few days later on June 18, 2000, in a commercial parking lot in the city of Rimouski, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014004908.CaseDesc: David Buckmire was last seen leaving his home in Toronto, Ontario, at approximately 12:00 p.m. on July 31, 2003.

Case reference: 2015049964.CaseDesc: Gerard Nziu was reported missing on September 16, 2015. His family had not heard from him since January 29th 1993, when he was in Montreal, Quebec. He was a foreign student in Canada at the time and his family has not heard from him since.

Case reference: 2014002222.CaseDesc: On September 9, 1958, at approximately 9:15 a.m., Cindy-Lou McLane was last seen playing outside of her residence in Willow River, British Columbia. There is a strong possibility that Cindy-Lou may have been abducted.

Case reference: 2012020116.CaseDesc: On April 1, 1975, Sylvie Ouimet left the Albert-Prevost institution, where she was hospitalized, without any of her personal effects. Her family has not heard from her since.

Scar: Ears, Surgical scar behind the ear

Case reference: 2018054180.CaseDesc: On May 8, 1992, John Leonard was seen for the last time when he borrowed a friend's vehicle.  Later that same day, the vehicle was recovered at Woodbine Racetrack in Toronto.

Shoes: Nylon, White, Running shoes with a low cut style
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Pair of dice

Case reference: 2016061231.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1968, an unidentified male was found hanging in a hotel room. He had checked in under the name Henry Drendorf. No identification was found. This individual was found with several bags of architectural books.

Case reference: 2014005439.CaseDesc: John Sparrow was last seen in April or May of 2001, getting into an early 1990s black Chevrolet pick-up truck while accompanied by an unknown male driver. John and the unknown man left the parking lot of the Denny's restaurant located at Benson Ave and Division St, in the city of Kingston, Ontario and headed north past highway #401.

Case reference: 2016060399.CaseDesc: On October 3, 1975, the skeletal remains of a male were found in the brush on Sparrow Lake Road (Lot 23 Con 14) in Orillia. His post-mortem length was recorded as being between 5'8"-5'9" however; this measurement may not represent his actual living height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.  A pair of nail clippers was also found nearby. His death is estimated to have occurred in the spring or summer prior.

Teeth: No dental work, missing a few teeth in upper jaw.
Scarf: Orange, Knitted gold-coloured material, possibly a scarf or sweater
Shoes: Brown leather clog-type shoes with a raised Cuban heel, size 7-8
Tie: Red, white, and blue material with curved design - possibly a necktie or head band
Underwear: White, Undershirt with label, partial initials "MP" followed by "LAN", beneath these "PETTIN"

Case reference: 2014003814.CaseDesc: On April 27, 1980, Leon Kitchekesik and his parents were staying at their cabin on Gull Lake. Leon was walking along the shore with his three year old sister. The parents went to investigate when they heard the screams of their daughter. The parents located footprints approaching a small hole and none leading away from the hole. There was a land search conducted however it is felt the boy drowned.

Case reference: 2014019687.CaseDesc: On November 23, 2013, an unidentified partial male skull was found in a forested area along a power line in Anmore near Coquitlam, BC. The decedent has likely been missing for several years.

Deformity: Head, Fractured facial bones. Underwent surgery to his skull, possibly during the 1980s or 1990s

Case reference: 2006014699.CaseDesc: On September 28, 1996, at approximately 2:00 a.m., Melanie Ethier was seen for the last time as she left a friend’s residence to walk to her residence in New Liskeard, Ontario. The distance between her home and her friend’s residence was a kilometre, but Melanie never arrived home. Foul play is suspected.

Shirt: Cotton, White, a blue heart ("Pepe" logo) t-shirt

Case reference: 2025060546.CaseDesc:
David Rowlands was reported missing by his family on October 31, 2025, and was last heard from on July 2, 2024. His last known location was a residence in New Westminster, British Columbia, but police have been unable to locate him in the Lower Mainland.
David's tendency to become disconnected from his family for extended periods was well-documented. A precedent has already established itself with him having previously resided in Mexico. Over the past five years, he has resided in New Westminster and Langley (BC), Calgary (AB), Halifax (NS), as well as in the UK and Mexico.

Case reference: 2020008361.CaseDesc: On May 12, 1991, at approximately 4:00pm, Ian Dickson was last seen leaving a restaurant near Yonge Street and Eglington Avenue in Toronto, Ontario. Ian was visiting from Scotland, and was due to return on May 23, but he did not board his flight.

Case reference: 2015005930.CaseDesc: On January 31st, 2015 Ali Jamil was seen for the last time in the area of Prospect Point, Niagara Falls, New York, USA. At the time of his disappearance, Ali was despondent.

Case reference: 2014001414.CaseDesc: Sarah Ovayuak was last seen on September 15, 1967, in Tuktoyaktuk, Northwest Territories.  Sarah fell into the Tuktoyaktuk Harbour while trying to board a Coast Guard vessel.

Case reference: 2006013999.CaseDesc: Walter Glynn was last seen on July 23, 1980 walking southbound on Main Street, Kirkland Lake.  He was heading to the A&P grocery store at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2016066066.CaseDesc: On November 23, 2016, at approximately 5:00 p.m., Kevin Dilk was seen for the last time as he left his residence in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Kevin has not been seen or heard from since this time.

Case reference: 2015011654.CaseDesc: On December 3, 1994, a baby was found in the Rivière des Prairies between the island of Montréal and the Visitation park Island in the Ahuntsic neighborhood. The body was naked and had a plastic bag wrapped around the wrist. According to experts the body would have been in the water since the fall.

Case reference: 2014002350.CaseDesc: On May 29th, 1990, Pierre Beaudoin left his residence in Hebron, Prince Edward Island. Police later confirmed that Pierre stayed at the Hotel Francis in New Richmond, Quebec and was seen for the last time on May 31, 1990, when he checked out of the hotel. Pierre’s truck and personal belongings were found in a dense, wooded area approximately 72 kilometers southeast of Route 275 in Balmoral, New Brunswick on August 17th, 1990.

Case reference: 2006016899.CaseDesc: Lisa Maas was last seen leaving a party in the Woodford area.

Case reference: 2010006499.CaseDesc: On May 23, 2007, Mark Brazau was reported missing by a friend.  Mark was last seen at his place of work in Toronto Ontario.

Hair: Brown, Short, Over ears, receding hairline, beard and a moustache

Case reference: 2020010632.CaseDesc: April Parisian was last seen at Yale, British Columbia, on or about March 28, 2021. April has not been seen or heard since.

Case reference: 2014004805.CaseDesc: Patrick Ratto was reported missing from his Burnaby residence July 27, 2006. There have been no confirmed sightings of Mr. Ratto since his disappearance. Mr. Ratto previously resided in Quebec and may have moved back. The Burnaby RCMP would like to speak with anyone who has any information on Mr. Ratto's whereabouts.

Hair: Brown, Short, Small brown & grey goatee
Jacket: Black, White, Windbreaker with white markings and a logo

Case reference: 2014004748.CaseDesc: On February 26, 2006, Diana “Daya” Gregory was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta. On that day, Diana had planned to visit her sister, but did not show up. She is known to use the Edmonton Transit Service (ETS) when she travelled within the city, and resided in the downtown core.

Case reference: 2006005299.CaseDesc: On August 22, 1970, Joseph Valem and two friends went fishing in a 16 foot fibreglass boat. Their boat sank on Georgian Bay, near Giants Tomb Island.  Joseph is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2007001599.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1988, Robert St. Louis was seen for the last time when left his home in the Laval-Ouest district in Laval, Quebec. Robert left without his wallet and truck keys. No one has seen or heard from him since.

Case reference: 2017043661.CaseDesc: In February of 2017, Robert Kovacs was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. He was taken from Canada to Romania by his mother, Kinga Costiniuc.

Case reference: 2019053661.CaseDesc:
On July 2, 1988, an unidentified man was found in the parking lot of the Value Village
on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had suffered from a
heart attack, and the results of his autopsy showed evidence of previous heart damage and a case of mild chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

Case reference: 2018055666.CaseDesc: On October 18, 1991, Kristina Rhodes was seen for the last time in Port Elgin, Ontario. Kristina was also known to frequent the towns of Southampton and Hanover, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014003746.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1972, Mario Cardinal was reported missing by his family. At the time of his disappearance, he lived in Trois-Rivières, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014002368.CaseDesc: On June 11, 1969, at approximately 5:50 p.m., the Happy Valley-Goose Bay RCMP received a report of an empty boat drifting in Lake Melville, in the vicinity of North West Point, in North West River, Newfoundland & Labrador.  Police attended the scene and learned that this empty boat belonged to Lawrence Alton Oliver, who had departed his residence earlier that morning to go seal hunting.  It is believed that Lawrence fell overboard while hunting and drowned, his body has never been located.

Boots: Rubber, Brown, Red, Rubber hip waders with a red band

Case reference: 2014002472.CaseDesc: In April 1988, Stacey Rogers was seen for the last time as she left her residence in Taylor, British Columbia. Stacey had stated that she was planning on travelling to Edmonton, Alberta, but did not go to Edmonton. It is possible that she went to Grande Prairie, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014002185.CaseDesc: On May 30, 1977, Géraldine Dufresne was seen for the last time at her residence in the Montréal-Nord district of Montreal, Quebec. Géraldine did not report to work, nor did she inform her employer of her absence. All of her belongings were left in her apartment.

Case reference: 2025003357.CaseDesc: On January 20, 2025, Iyan Brertton was reported missing by his family. The last contact between Iyan and his family was on April 19, 2024.  It is known that he frequents the inner city and west side of Edmonton, Alberta. Iyan also has connections to Saddle Lake in Alberta.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, Faded cross and initials "IB"

Case reference: 2014003731.CaseDesc: On October 30, 1964, Murray Hansen departed from Berens River, Manitoba, on a boat bound for Black River. On that day, the weather deteriorated, with stormy conditions and rough water on the lake. After an extended absence, his wife initiated a search for him, which revealed that he had not actually arrived in Black River. On November 3, his vessel was discovered capsized in proximity to Bigstone Point. A search was conducted by air, land and water, but his body was never recovered. It is presumed that Murray died from drowning.

Case reference: 2006021699.CaseDesc: Karl Anderson was last seen on September 3, 1974 in Upsala, Ontario. It was thought that he possibly travelled by train to Sioux Lookout or Thunder Bay to seek medical treatment.

Case reference: 2013000041.CaseDesc: David Luborsky was reported missing on the 4th of November 2010. David was last seen leaving the Parklane Residence which is situated at 1095 Merivale Road, in the City of Ottawa.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Irishman holding a beer
Right Side Of Neck, Clover leaf

Case reference: 2014002718.CaseDesc: Wayne Robinson was last seen on October 8, 1985, running away from his school in God's Lake, Manitoba. It is unclear what prompted Wayne to leave school during the recess period. An extensive air, water and land search was conducted with no success.

Case reference: 2014003706.CaseDesc: On September 14, 1974, Albert Crow and a friend attempted to cross Harrop Lake, Manitoba, in a canoe, despite high winds and rough water. A second party in another canoe was ahead of Albert's and at one point in the crossing observed that the canoe was no longer visible. The shoreline was searched and the lake dragged without success. On October 12, 1974, the body of his friend was recovered. The cause of his death was later determined to have been by drowning. Albert is also believed to have died as a result of drowning.

Case reference: 2014004617.CaseDesc: Richard Deren was last seen in Vancouver on March 12, 2005. He disappeared and neither his family nor friends had heard from him. This was unusual behaviour for him not to keep in contact with his friends.

Case reference: 2014001462.CaseDesc: On August 18, 1995, Gareth Austin and Dominic Park were seen for the last time in Medicine Hat, Alberta.

Scar: Left Hand, Scar top of left hand
